description: Test questions for a chatbot answering from the Mock Bank Customer Account Policy. in_policy=false questions should be answered with a refusal or a referral, not an invented answer.

questions.question: I lost my debit card last month and got a replacement. I've just lost it again. Will I be charged for another one?
questions.expected_answer: Yes. The first lost or stolen card replacement in 12 months is free; subsequent ones cost £5.00. Delivery takes 3–5 working days.

questions.question: I have a Premier account. Do I have to pay the £15 monthly fee?
questions.expected_answer: The £15.00 monthly fee is waived in any month you pay in £5,000 or more.

questions.question: I want to send £3,000 to someone I've never paid before from my Everyday account. Can I do it in one go?
questions.expected_answer: No. The first payment to a new payee on an Everyday account is limited to £1,000 and is held for 4 hours for checks.
questions.test_focus: New payee limit overriding the higher per-transaction limit

questions.question: Is my local branch open on Sunday?
questions.expected_answer: No. Branches are closed on Sundays and bank holidays. Telephone banking is open Sunday 10:00–16:00, and the app, online banking and the lost/stolen card line are available 24/7.

questions.question: How much cash can I take out of an ATM in one day with an Everyday account, and when does the limit reset?
questions.expected_answer: £500 per day. Daily limits reset at midnight UK time.

questions.question: What happens if I try to spend more than my balance and I don't have an overdraft set up?
questions.expected_answer: Unarranged overdrafts are not permitted, so the payment is declined. There is no fee for a declined payment.

questions.question: I'm a Premier customer on holiday in Spain and my card was stolen. How quickly can I get a new one, and what will it cost?
questions.expected_answer: An emergency card abroad arrives within 2 working days and is free for Premier customers (normally £30.00). Report the theft immediately in the app or on 0800 000 0000 (24/7).

questions.question: What interest rate does the Mock Saver Account pay?
questions.expected_answer: The policy names the Mock Saver Account but does not state its interest rate. The bot should say it doesn't have that information and refer the customer to the bank.
questions.test_focus: Hallucination trap: the product is mentioned but the detail is missing

questions.question: If I pay a cheque into a branch, how long until the money is in my account?
questions.expected_answer: Cheque clearing times are not covered by the policy. The bot should say so and refer the customer to the bank, without guessing a timeframe.
questions.test_focus: Plausible banking topic absent from the policy

questions.question: Can I open a joint account with my partner, and what ID do we need?
questions.expected_answer: Joint accounts and account-opening ID requirements are not covered by the policy. The bot should not infer them from the 'ID checks' mentioned for CHAPS or limit increases.
questions.test_focus: Out of scope, with nearby keywords that could mislead retrieval
